title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → FERPARestriction

source_tables.description: FERPA indicator. Tracks which directory information categories a student has restricted.
FERPA restriction type definitions. Categories of directory information.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Array of restricted directory info categories: 'name', 'address', 'phone', 'email', 'photo', 'enrollment_status', 'dates_of_attendance', 'degree_info', 'honors', 'all'.
true if all directory info categories are restricted.

notes: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) allows students to restrict disclosure of directory information. This is a compliance-critical dataset — any system that displays or shares student data must check FERPA restrictions. A total restriction means NO directory information can be disclosed, including confirming enrollment. Classification is RESTRICTED because the existence of a FERPA restriction is itself protected.
